title: Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Amendment No 2) Bill
what_it_is: Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Amendment No 2) Bill

sections.label: Bill Second Reading vote
sections.summary: The Bill's Second Reading requires support from at least two-thirds of Elected and Non-Constituency Members, which is 63 Members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: This Bill is related to the Singapore Armed Forces and Other Matters Bill, which this House has debated and passed for the establishment of the DIS.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The Question is, "That the Bill be now read a Second time." Pursuant to Article 5(2) of the Constitution, a vote is taken to ascertain that the Second Reading of the Bill is supported by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total number of Elected and Non-Constituency Members of Parliament, which is 63 Members.

sections.label: Second Reading carried, Third Reading vote
sections.summary: The Second Reading was carried with 75 Ayes and eight Noes, and a vote is taken for the Third Reading.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: I will proceed to declare the voting results now.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The Second Reading of the Bill has been carried by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total number of Elected and Non-Constituency Members of Parliament.    .

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The Question is, "That the Bill be now read a Third time."  Pursuant to Article 5(2) of the Constitution, a vote is taken to ascertain that the Third Reading of the Bill is supported by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total number of Elected and Non-Constituency Members of Parliament, which is 63 Members.

sections.label: Third Reading carried
sections.summary: The Third Reading was carried with 75 Ayes and eight Noes, meeting the two-thirds requirement.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: I will proceed to declare the voting results now.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The Third Reading of the Bill has been carried by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total number of Elected and Non-Constituency Members of Parliament.
